description: Builds a link that opens Haven's financing simulator prefilled with a scenario, where the investor can review it and apply. Creates nothing and submits nothing; the link carries no personal data.

collateralValue.description: Market value of the eligible brokerage portfolio pledged as collateral, in USD.

drawAmount.description: Cash to borrow, in USD. Minimum $50,000.

rateType.description: fixed: rate set for the term at execution. variable: resets monthly at the 1M rate.

source.description: Optional short label for the client creating the link, e.g. chatgpt. Recorded as utm_source.

term.description: Fixed-rate term: 3M, 6M, 12M (or 1Y) or 2Y. Ignored for variable financing.

name: create_onboarding_link
title: Create a prefilled onboarding link
